ns2:section.sectionText: In this course, we examine scholarly approaches to the study of music and the natural environment. How can musical representations of landscapes and soundscapes convey nostalgic memories of threatened or lost environments? Are the sounds of nature musical, and can non-human animal sounds be affected by human sounds? Can music raise awareness about ecological crises? How is traditional ecological knowledge intertwined with musical practices for some indigenous and rural peoples? Is rock music?and touring stage shows that emphasize spectacle?an environmentally sustainable enterprise?
